overview_description.description: Zazos is the all-in-one people platform that molds to your company’s reality. Start with apps for hiring, performance, or engagement, then customize or expand them as your needs grow. With no-code tools and support from our solution architects, Zazos evolves with you — not the other way around.

about_short_description.short_description: Zazos unifies people processes in one place. Use built-in apps, customize them, or create your own with no-code.

product.name: Avaliação de Desempenho Essencial
product.description: A tool to implement performance evaluations including peer, leader, subordinate, and self-assessments within a company.

product.name: eNPS
product.description: An anonymous employee engagement survey tool that measures team satisfaction and provides automated insights.

product.name: OKRs
product.description: A platform to set, track, and visualize company and team objectives and key results in real time.

product.name: Performance Mensal
product.description: A monthly performance tracking tool that facilitates continuous feedback and alignment between leaders and employees.

product.name: Reconhecimentos
product.description: A peer recognition system that allows employees to acknowledge colleagues and link recognitions to company values.

product.name: Recrutamento
product.description: A recruitment management system that organizes hiring processes, automates communications, and integrates with LinkedIn and other platforms.
